verses.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.modern: In the beginning was the Word. The Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.modern: He was with God in the beginning.

verses.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.modern: All things were made through Him. Nothing that has been made was made without Him.

verses.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.modern: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.

verses.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.modern: The light shines in darkness, and the darkness comprehended it not.

verses.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.modern: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.

verses.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
verses.modern: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that all might believe through Him.

verses.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.modern: He was not the Light, but came to bear witness to the Light.

verses.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.modern: The true Light, which gives light to every man, was coming into the world.

verses.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.modern: He was in the world. The world was made through Him, yet the world did not know Him.

verses.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.modern: He came to His own people, and His own people did not receive Him.

verses.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.modern: But to all who did receive Him — to those who believed in His name — He gave the right to become children of God.

verses.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.modern: These were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

verses.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.modern: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw His glory — the glory of the only begotten of the Father — full of grace and truth.

verses.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.modern: John testified about him and cried out, "This is the one I spoke of: He who comes after me ranks above me, because he was before me."

verses.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.modern: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.

verses.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: The law was given through Moses. Grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.modern: No one has ever seen God. The only begotten Son, who is in the Father's embrace, has made Him known.

verses.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.modern: This is John's testimony: when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask Him, "Who are You?"

verses.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.modern: He did not refuse to answer. He openly declared, "I am not the Christ."

verses.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.modern: They asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.modern: Then they said, "Who are you? We need to give an answer to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

verses.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.modern: He replied, "I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness: 'Make straight the way of the Lord,' as the prophet Isaiah said."

verses.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.modern: Now those who were sent were from the Pharisees.

verses.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.modern: They questioned Him further: "Then why do You baptize, if You are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"

verses.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.modern: John answered them, "I baptize with water. But there is one standing among You whom You do not know.

verses.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.modern: He is the one who comes after me, but ranks before me. I am not worthy to untie the strap of His sandal."

verses.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.modern: These things took place in Bethabara, beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

verses.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.modern: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward Him and said, "Look — the Lamb of God, Who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.modern: This is He of whom I said, 'After me comes a man who ranks before me, because he was before me.'

verses.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.modern: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was so that He might be revealed to Israel."

verses.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.modern: Then John testified, "I saw the Spirit descend from heaven like a dove and remain on Him.

verses.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: I myself did not know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water told me, 'The one on whom You see the Spirit descend and remain — He is the one who baptizes with the Holy Ghost.'

verses.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.modern: I have seen it and I testify that this is the Son of God."

verses.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.modern: The next day John was standing there again with two of his disciples.

verses.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.modern: As He watched Jesus walk by, He said, "Look — the Lamb of God!"

verses.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.modern: The two disciples heard Him say this and they followed Jesus.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.modern: Jesus turned and saw them following and said to them, "What are You looking for?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which means Master), "where are You staying?"

verses.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Come and see." They came and saw where He was staying, and they stayed with Him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

verses.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
verses.modern: One of the two who heard John and followed Jesus was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

verses.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
verses.modern: Andrew first found his own brother Simon and said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which means the Christ).

verses.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.modern: He brought Him to Jesus. Jesus looked at Him and said, "You are Simon the son of Jona. You shall be called Cephas" (which means Peter, a rock).

verses.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.modern: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said to him, "Follow Me."

verses.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.modern: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

verses.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.modern: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and the prophets also wrote about — Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."

verses.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.modern: Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."

verses.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.modern: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him and said, "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit!"

verses.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.modern: Nathanael said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw You."

verses.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.modern: Nathanael answered Him, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Do You believe because I told You I saw You under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these."

verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.modern: He said to Him, "Truly, truly, I say to You, You will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."

chapters.summary: John declares that the eternal Word was with God and was God, and that through Him all things were made. The Word became flesh and dwelt among men. John the Baptist testifies that Jesus is the Lamb of God, and Jesus calls His first disciples — Andrew, Simon Peter, Philip, and Nathanael.

verses.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.modern: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.

verses.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.modern: Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.

verses.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.modern: When the wine ran out, the mother of Jesus said to Him, "They have no wine."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Woman, what does this have to do with Me? My hour has not yet come."

verses.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
verses.modern: His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever He tells You."

verses.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.modern: Now there were six stone water jars there for the Jewish rites of purification, each holding twenty or thirty gallons.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Fill the jars with water." They filled them to the brim.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.modern: Then He said to them, "Now draw some out and take it to the master of the feast." They took it.

verses.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.modern: When the master of the feast tasted the water now turned into wine — not knowing where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew — he called the bridegroom

verses.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.modern: and said to Him, "Everyone serves the good wine first, and then the cheaper wine after people have had plenty. But You have kept the good wine until now."

verses.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.modern: This was the first of Jesus's signs, done in Cana of Galilee. He revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.

verses.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.modern: After this He went down to Capernaum with His mother, His brothers, and His disciples. They stayed there only a few days.

verses.kjv: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
verses.modern: The Jews' Passover was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.modern: In the temple He found those who were selling oxen and sheep and doves, and the money-changers sitting at their tables.

verses.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.modern: Making a whip of cords, He drove them all out of the temple — the sheep and the oxen as well. He poured out the money-changers' coins and overturned their tables.

verses.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.modern: He said to those who sold doves, "Take these things away from here. Do not make My Father's house a house of trade."

verses.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.modern: His disciples remembered that it is written, "Zeal for Your house will consume Me."

verses.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.modern: The Jews then said to Him, "What sign can You show us for doing these things?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.modern: The Jews said, "This temple took forty-six years to build, and You will raise it up in three days?"

verses.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.modern: But He was speaking about the temple of His body.

verses.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.modern: When He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. They believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.

verses.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.modern: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover feast, many believed in His name when they saw the signs He was doing.

verses.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
verses.modern: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, because He knew all people.

verses.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
verses.modern: He had no need for anyone to testify about man, for he himself knew what was in man.

chapters.summary: Jesus attends a wedding in Cana of Galilee and turns water into wine, His first miracle. He travels to Jerusalem for the Passover and drives the money changers out of the temple, declaring, 'Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.'

verses.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.modern: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

verses.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.modern: He came to Jesus by night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do unless God is with Him."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "Truly, truly, I say to You, unless a man is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God."

verses.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.modern: Nicodemus said to him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter his mother's womb a second time and be born?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I say to You, unless a man is born of water and of the Spirit, He cannot enter the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.modern: What is born of the flesh is flesh, and what is born of the Spirit is spirit.

verses.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.modern: Do not be amazed that I said to You, 'You must be born again.'

verses.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.modern: The wind blows where it will. You hear its sound, but You do not know where it comes from or where it goes. That is how it is with everyone born of the Spirit."

verses.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.modern: Nicodemus said to him, "How can these things be?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "You are a teacher of Israel and You do not understand these things?

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, we speak of what we know and testify to what we have seen, but You do not receive our testimony.

verses.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.modern: If I have told You earthly things and You do not believe, how will You believe if I tell You heavenly things?

verses.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.modern: No one has ascended into heaven except he who descended from heaven — the Son of Man Who is in heaven.

verses.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.modern: Just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

verses.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.modern: so that everyone who believes in Him may not perish but have eternal life.

verses.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.modern: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, so that everyone who believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

verses.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.modern: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but so that the world might be saved through Him.

verses.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.modern: Whoever believes in him is not condemned. But whoever does not believe is condemned already, because He has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

verses.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.modern: This is the judgment: the light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness rather than the light, because their deeds were evil.

verses.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.modern: Everyone who does evil hates the light and does not come to the light, for fear that His deeds will be exposed.

verses.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.modern: But whoever does what is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that His deeds have been done in God.

verses.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.modern: After this Jesus and His disciples went into the land of Judaea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

verses.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.modern: John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because water was plentiful there. People came and were baptized.

verses.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.modern: For John had not yet been thrown into prison.

verses.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.modern: A dispute arose between some of John's disciples and a Jew about purification.

verses.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, he baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.modern: They came to John and said, "Rabbi, the one who was with you beyond the Jordan — the one You testified about — He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him."

verses.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.modern: John answered, "A man can receive nothing unless it is given to him from heaven.

verses.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.modern: You yourselves can testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ,' but that I have been sent before Him.

verses.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.modern: The one who has the bride is the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears Him, greatly rejoices at the bridegroom's voice. This joy of mine is now complete.

verses.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.modern: He must increase, but I must decrease.

verses.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.modern: He who comes from above is above all. He who is of the earth is earthly and speaks of earthly things. He who comes from heaven is above all.

verses.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.modern: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one receives his testimony.

verses.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.modern: Whoever receives his testimony has certified that God is true.

verses.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.modern: He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God does not give the Spirit by measure to Him.

verses.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.modern: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into His hand.

verses.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.modern: Whoever believes in the Son has everlasting life. Whoever does not obey the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God remains on Him.

chapters.summary: Nicodemus, a Pharisee and ruler of the Jews, comes to Jesus by night, and Jesus tells him that a man must be born again to see the kingdom of God. Jesus declares that God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

verses.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.modern: When the Lord learned that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

verses.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.modern: (though Jesus Himself did not baptize, but His disciples did),

verses.kjv: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.modern: He left Judaea and went back to Galilee.

verses.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.modern: He had to pass through Samaria.

verses.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.modern: So He came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the field that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

verses.kjv: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.modern: Jacob's well was there. Jesus, tired from the journey, sat down beside the well. It was about the sixth hour.

verses.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.modern: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give Me a drink."

verses.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.modern: His disciples had gone into the city to buy food.

verses.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.modern: The Samaritan woman said to Him, "How is it that You, a Jew, ask a drink of me, a woman of Samaria?" For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.modern: Jesus answered her, "If You knew the gift of God, and who it is that is saying to You, 'Give Me a drink,' you would have asked Him, and He would have given You living water."

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.modern: The woman said to him, "Sir, you have no bucket, and the well is deep. Where do You get that living water?

verses.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.modern: Are You greater than our father Jacob? He gave us the well and drank from it himself, along with his sons and his livestock."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.modern: Jesus answered her, "Everyone who drinks of this water will be thirsty again.

verses.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.modern: But whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again. The water that I will give Him will become in Him a spring of water welling up to everlasting life."

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.modern: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water, so that I will not be thirsty or have to come here to draw water."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Go, call Your husband, and come back here."

verses.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.modern: The woman answered him, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You are right in saying, 'I have no husband.'

verses.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.modern: You have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You spoke the truth."

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.modern: The woman said to him, "Sir, I see that you are a prophet.

verses.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.modern: Our fathers worshipped on this mountain, but you Jews say that Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming when You will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.modern: You worship what You do not know. We worship what we know, for salvation is from the Jews.

verses.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.modern: But the hour is coming — and is now here — when true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth. The Father is seeking such people to worship Him.

verses.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.modern: God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and in truth."

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.modern: The woman said to him, "I know that Messiah is coming (He who is called Christ). When He comes, He will tell us all things."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "I who speak to You am He."

verses.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.modern: Just then His disciples came back. They were surprised that He was talking with a woman, but no one said, "What are you seeking?" or "Why are you talking with her?"

verses.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.modern: The woman left her water jar and went back into the city. She said to the people,

verses.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.modern: "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"

verses.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.modern: They left the city and came to Him.

verses.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.modern: Meanwhile, His disciples urged Him, saying, "Rabbi, eat something."

verses.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.modern: But He said to them, "I have food to eat that You do not know about."

verses.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.modern: So the disciples said to one another, "Has anyone brought him something to eat?"

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.

verses.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.modern: Do You not say, 'There are yet four months, and then comes the harvest'? Look, I tell You — lift up Your eyes and see that the fields are already white for harvest.

verses.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.modern: The reaper is already receiving His wages and gathering fruit for eternal life, so that the sower and reaper may rejoice together.

verses.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.modern: For in this the saying holds true: 'One sows and another reaps.'

verses.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.modern: I sent You to reap what You did not work for. Others have worked, and You have entered into their labor."

verses.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.modern: Many Samaritans from that city believed in Him because of the woman's testimony: "He told me everything I ever did."

verses.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.modern: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

verses.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.modern: Many more believed because of His own word.

verses.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.modern: They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what You said. We have heard Him ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world."

verses.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.modern: After the two days He departed from there for Galilee.

verses.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.modern: For Jesus Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in His own hometown.

verses.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.modern: When He arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed Him, having seen all the things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast — for they had also gone to the feast.

verses.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.modern: Jesus came again to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. There was a royal official whose son was sick in Capernaum.

verses.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.modern: When this man heard that Jesus had come from Judaea to Galilee, He went to Him and begged Him to come down and heal His son, who was close to death.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Unless You see signs and wonders, You will not believe."

verses.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.modern: The official said to Him, "Sir, come down before my child dies."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Go. Your son will live." The man believed the word that Jesus had spoken to Him and went on His way.

verses.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.modern: As He was on His way down, His servants met him and told him, "Your son is alive."

verses.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.modern: He asked them the hour when He had begun to recover. They said to Him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left Him."

verses.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.modern: The father knew it was the same hour when Jesus had said to Him, "Your son will live." He Himself believed, and His whole household.

verses.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.modern: This was the second sign Jesus did after coming from Judaea into Galilee.

chapters.summary: Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman at Jacob's well, revealing that He is the Messiah and offering her living water. Many Samaritans believe because of His words. He then heals a nobleman's son in Capernaum from a distance, His second sign.

verses.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.modern: Now there is in Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, a pool called Bethesda in Hebrew, which has five covered colonnades.

verses.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.modern: In these lay a great crowd of sick people — the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed — waiting for the moving of the water.

verses.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.modern: For at certain times an angel went down into the pool and stirred the water. Whoever stepped in first after the water was stirred was healed of whatever disease He had.

verses.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.modern: One man there had been ill for thirty-eight years.

verses.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.modern: When Jesus saw Him lying there and knew that He had already been there a long time, He said to Him, "Do You want to be made well?"

verses.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.modern: The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am making my way, someone else steps in before me."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Get up, pick up Your mat, and walk."

verses.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.modern: Immediately the man was made well. He picked up his mat and walked. Now that day was the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.modern: So the Jews said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry your mat."

verses.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.modern: He answered them, "The man who made me well said to me, 'Pick up your mat and walk.'"

verses.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.modern: They asked him, "Who is the man who said to you, 'Pick up your mat and walk'?"

verses.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.modern: The man who had been healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was in the place.

verses.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.modern: Afterward Jesus found Him in the temple and said to Him, "See — you are well! Sin no more, or something worse may happen to You."

verses.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.modern: The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus Who had made Him well.

verses.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.modern: This was why the Jews were persecuting Jesus — because He was doing these things on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.modern: But Jesus answered them, "My Father is working until now, and I am working."

verses.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.modern: This made the Jews all the more determined to kill Him — not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.

verses.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I say to You, the Son can do nothing on His own — only what He sees the Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son does likewise.

verses.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.modern: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him everything He Himself does. He will show Him even greater works than these, so that You will be amazed.

verses.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.modern: For just as the Father raises the dead and quickens them, so also the Son quickens whom He will.

verses.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.modern: The Father judges no one, but has given all judgment to the Son,

verses.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.modern: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, whoever hears My word and believes in him who sent Me has everlasting life. He does not come into condemnation but has passed from death to life.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, the hour is coming — and is now here — when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.

verses.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.modern: For as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son also to have life in Himself.

verses.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.modern: He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.modern: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in the graves will hear His voice

verses.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.modern: and will come out — those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of damnation.

verses.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.modern: I can do nothing on My own. I judge as I hear, and My judgment is just — because I seek not My own will but the will of Him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.modern: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not true.

verses.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.modern: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is true.

verses.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.modern: You sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

verses.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.modern: Not that I accept human testimony — but I say these things so that You may be saved.

verses.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.modern: John was a burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a time in His light.

verses.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.modern: But I have a testimony greater than John's. The works that the Father has given Me to accomplish — the very works that I am doing — bear witness about Me that the Father has sent Me.

verses.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.modern: The Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice or seen His form.

verses.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.modern: You do not have His word living in You, for You do not believe the one He has sent.

verses.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.modern: You search the Scriptures because You think that in them You have eternal life. It is they that testify about Me,

verses.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.modern: yet You refuse to come to Me so that You may have life.

verses.kjv: I receive not honour from men.
verses.modern: I do not receive glory from people.

verses.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.modern: But I know You — you do not have the love of God within You.

verses.kjv: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.modern: I have come in My Father's name, and You do not receive Me. If another comes in His own name, You will receive Him.

verses.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
verses.modern: How can You believe, when You receive glory from one another and do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?

verses.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
verses.modern: Do not think that I will accuse You to the Father. There is one who accuses You — Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

verses.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
verses.modern: If you believed Moses, you would believe Me — for he wrote about Me.

verses.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.modern: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"

chapters.summary: Jesus heals a man who had been lame for thirty-eight years at the pool of Bethesda on the Sabbath. The Jews persecute Him for healing on the Sabbath, and Jesus declares that He does what He sees the Father doing, claiming equal authority with God to give life and execute judgment.

verses.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.modern: After these things Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, also called the Sea of Tiberias.

verses.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.modern: A great crowd followed Him, because they saw the miracles He was doing on the sick.

verses.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.modern: Jesus went up on a mountain and sat down there with His disciples.

verses.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.modern: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.

verses.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.modern: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread so that these people may eat?"

verses.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.modern: He said this to test Him, for He Himself knew what He was going to do.

verses.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.modern: Philip answered him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread would not be enough for each one of them to get even a little."

verses.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.modern: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to him,

verses.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.modern: "There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fish. But what are they for so many people?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." There was plenty of grass in the place. So the men sat down, about five thousand in number.

verses.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.modern: Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks, He distributed them to those who were seated. He did the same with the fish, giving out as much as they wanted.

verses.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.modern: When they had all eaten their fill, He said to His disciples, "Gather up the leftover pieces so that nothing is wasted."

verses.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.modern: So they gathered them up and filled twelve baskets with the pieces left over from the five barley loaves — what remained after everyone had eaten.

verses.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.modern: When the people saw the miracle Jesus had done, they said, "This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world!"

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.modern: Jesus, knowing that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, withdrew again to the mountain by Himself alone.

verses.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.modern: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea.

verses.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.modern: They got into a boat and started across the sea toward Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.

verses.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.modern: The sea grew rough because a strong wind was blowing.

verses.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.modern: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat. They were frightened.

verses.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.modern: But He said to them, "It is I. Do not be afraid."

verses.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.modern: Then they were glad to receive Him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the land where they were going.

verses.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.modern: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the other side of the sea saw that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not gotten into it with His disciples — His disciples had gone away alone.

verses.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.modern: Other boats from Tiberias came near the place where they had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

verses.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.modern: So when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum looking for Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.modern: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You get here?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I say to You, You are looking for Me not because You saw miracles, but because You ate the loaves and were filled.

verses.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.modern: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures to everlasting life — which the Son of Man will give You. For on Him God the Father has set His seal."

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.modern: They said to Him, "What must we do to be doing the works of God?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "This is the work of God: that You believe in Him whom He has sent."

verses.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.modern: So they said to Him, "Then what sign will You do, so that we may see it and believe You? What work will You perform?

verses.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.modern: Our fathers ate manna in the wilderness. As it is written, 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'"

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to You, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven. My Father gives You the true bread from heaven.

verses.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.modern: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.modern: They said to Him, "Lord, give us this bread always."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me shall never hunger, and whoever believes in Me shall never thirst.

verses.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.modern: But I told You that You have seen Me and still do not believe.

verses.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.modern: All that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and whoever comes to Me I will never cast out.

verses.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.modern: For I have come down from heaven not to do My own will but the will of Him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.modern: This is the will of Him who sent Me: that I should lose none of all He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.

verses.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.modern: For this is the will of My Father: that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have everlasting life, and I will raise Him up at the last day."

verses.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.modern: The Jews grumbled about Him because He said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."

verses.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.modern: They said, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, 'I have come down from heaven'?"

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Stop grumbling among yourselves.

verses.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.modern: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws Him. And I will raise Him up at the last day.

verses.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.modern: It is written in the Prophets: 'They shall all be taught by God.' Everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to Me.

verses.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.modern: Not that anyone has seen the Father except the one who is from God — He has seen the Father.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, whoever believes in Me has everlasting life.

verses.kjv: I am that bread of life.
verses.modern: I am the bread of life.

verses.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.modern: Your fathers ate manna in the wilderness, and they died.

verses.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.modern: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that one may eat of it and not die.

verses.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.modern: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. The bread that I will give is My flesh, which I will give for the life of the world."

verses.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.modern: The Jews then argued with one another, saying, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.modern: So Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to You, unless You eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, You have no life in You.

verses.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.modern: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise Him up at the last day.

verses.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.modern: For My flesh is true food, and My blood is true drink.

verses.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.modern: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood abides in Me, and I in Him.

verses.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.modern: As the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, so whoever feeds on Me will also live because of Me.

verses.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.modern: This is the bread that came down from heaven — not like the bread the fathers ate and died. Whoever eats this bread will live forever."

verses.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.modern: He said these things while teaching in the synagogue at Capernaum.

verses.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.modern: When many of His disciples heard this, they said, "This is a hard saying. Who can accept it?"

verses.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.modern: But Jesus, knowing in Himself that His disciples were grumbling about it, said to them, "Does this offend You?

verses.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.modern: What if You were to see the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?

verses.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.modern: It is the Spirit Who quickens — the flesh is of no help at all. The words that I have spoken to You are spirit and they are life.

verses.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.modern: But there are some of You who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who those were who did not believe, and who it was that would betray Him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.modern: He said, "This is why I told You that no one can come to Me unless it is granted him by the Father."

verses.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.modern: After this, many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.modern: So Jesus said to the twelve, "Do You want to go away as well?"

verses.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.modern: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

verses.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.modern: We have come to believe and to know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose You, the twelve? And yet one of You is a devil."

verses.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.modern: He spoke of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon — for it was he who would betray him, though he was one of the twelve.

chapters.summary: Jesus feeds five thousand men with five barley loaves and two small fish, then walks on the sea to His disciples' boat. He declares, 'I am the bread of life,' and teaches that whoever eats His flesh and drinks His blood has eternal life. Many disciples leave Him, but Peter confesses, 'You have the words of eternal life.'

verses.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.modern: After this, Jesus traveled through Galilee. He would not go through Judea because the Jews were seeking to kill Him.

verses.kjv: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.modern: Now the Jews' Feast of Tabernacles was near.

verses.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.modern: His brothers said to Him, "Leave here and go to Judea so Your disciples there can see the works You are doing.

verses.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.modern: No one does things in secret when he wants to be known openly. If You do these things, show Yourself to the world."

verses.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.modern: For not even His brothers believed in Him.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet come, but Your time is always ready.

verses.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.modern: The world cannot hate You, but it hates Me because I testify that its works are evil.

verses.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
verses.modern: You go up to the feast. I am not going up to this feast yet, because My time has not yet fully come."

verses.kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
verses.modern: After saying this, He stayed in Galilee.

verses.kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.modern: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, then He also went up — not openly, but in private.

verses.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.modern: The Jews were looking for Him at the feast and said, "Where is He?"

verses.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.modern: There was a lot of muttering about him among the crowd. Some said, "He is a good man." Others said, "No — He leads the people astray."

verses.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.modern: But no one spoke openly about him out of fear of the Jews.

verses.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.modern: About the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and began teaching.

verses.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.modern: The Jews were amazed and said, "How does this man know so much, having never studied?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "My teaching is not My own. It comes from Him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
verses.modern: If anyone chooses to do God's will, He will know whether this teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.

verses.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.modern: Whoever speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory. But whoever seeks the glory of him who sent him — that man is true, and there is no falsehood in him.

verses.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.modern: Did Moses not give you the law? Yet none of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill Me?"

verses.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.modern: The crowd answered, "You have a devil! Who is trying to kill You?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "I did one work, and You are all amazed.

verses.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.modern: Moses gave you circumcision — not that it came from Moses, but from the fathers — and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.modern: If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath so the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry at Me for making a man completely well on the Sabbath?

verses.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.modern: Do not judge by outward appearances. Judge with right judgment."

verses.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.modern: Some of the people of Jerusalem said, "Is this not the man they are trying to kill?

verses.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
verses.modern: Here He is, speaking openly, and they say nothing to Him! Can it be that the rulers really know that this is the Christ?

verses.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.modern: Yet we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where he is from."

verses.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.modern: Then Jesus cried out in the temple as He taught, "You know Me, and You know where I am from. But I have not come on My own. He who sent Me is true, and him you do not know.

verses.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.modern: I know Him, for I am from Him, and He sent Me."

verses.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.modern: Then they tried to arrest Him, but no one laid hands on him, because his hour had not yet come.

verses.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
verses.modern: Yet many in the crowd believed in Him. They said, "When the Christ comes, will He do more signs than this man has done?"

verses.kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.modern: The Pharisees heard the crowd muttering these things about Him. The chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to arrest Him.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "I am with You only a little while longer, and then I go to Him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
verses.modern: You will look for Me but will not find Me. Where I am, You cannot come."

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
verses.modern: The Jews said to one another, "Where does He intend to go that we cannot find Him? Will He go to those scattered among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

verses.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
verses.modern: What does He mean when He says, 'You will look for Me but will not find Me,' and 'Where I am, You cannot come'?"

verses.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.modern: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and cried out, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.

verses.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.modern: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, out of His belly will flow rivers of living water."

verses.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
verses.modern: He said this about the Spirit, for the Holy Ghost had not yet been given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.

verses.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.modern: When the people heard these words, some of them said, "This really is the Prophet."

verses.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.modern: Others said, "This is the Christ." But others said, "Will the Christ come from Galilee?

verses.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.modern: Does the Scripture not say that the Christ comes from the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?"

verses.kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.modern: So there was a division among the people over him.

verses.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.modern: Some of them wanted to arrest Him, but no one laid hands on him.

verses.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.modern: The officers went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, "Why did You not bring Him?"

verses.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.modern: The officers answered, "No one ever spoke like this man!"

verses.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.modern: The Pharisees answered them, "Have you also been deceived?

verses.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.modern: Has any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in Him?

verses.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.modern: But this crowd, who do not know the law — they are accursed."
