verses.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
verses.modern: Nicodemus — the one who had come to Jesus before, and who was one of them — said to them,

verses.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.modern: "Does our law judge a man without first hearing from him and finding out what He is doing?"

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.modern: They answered Him, "Are You from Galilee too? Look it up — no prophet arises from Galilee."

verses.kjv: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.modern: Then everyone went to His own house.

chapters.summary: Jesus goes up to Jerusalem for the Feast of Tabernacles and teaches in the temple, dividing the crowds over whether He is the Christ. On the last day of the feast He cries out, 'If any man thirst, let him come to Me and drink.' The Pharisees send officers to arrest Him, but they return empty-handed.

verses.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.modern: Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.modern: Early in the morning He came again into the temple. All the people came to him, and he sat down and taught them.

verses.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.modern: The scribes and Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery. They placed her in front of everyone

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.modern: and said to Him, "Master, this woman was caught in the very act of adultery.

verses.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.modern: Moses commanded us in the law to stone such women. What do You say?"

verses.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.modern: They said this to trap Him, so they would have grounds to accuse Him. But Jesus bent down and wrote with His finger on the ground.

verses.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.modern: When they kept pressing Him, He stood up and said to them, "Let Him who is without sin among You be the first to throw a stone at her."

verses.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.modern: He bent down again and wrote on the ground.

verses.kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.modern: One by one, convicted by their own conscience, they went away — beginning with the oldest and ending with the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman standing before him.

verses.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.modern: Jesus stood up and said to her, "Woman, where are Your accusers? Has no one condemned you?"

verses.kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.modern: She said, "No one, Lord." Jesus said to her, "Neither do I condemn You. Go, and sin no more."

verses.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.modern: Jesus spoke to them again, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will not walk in darkness but will have the light of life."

verses.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.modern: The Pharisees said to Him, "You are testifying about Yourself. Your testimony is not true."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is true. I know where I came from and where I am going. But You do not know where I come from or where I am going.

verses.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.modern: You judge by human standards. I judge no one.

verses.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.modern: Yet even if I do judge, My judgment is true — for it is not I alone who judge, but I and the Father who sent Me.

verses.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.modern: It is written in Your law that the testimony of two men is true.

verses.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.modern: I am one who testifies about Myself, and the Father who sent Me testifies about Me."

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.modern: They said to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither Me nor My Father. If You knew Me, You would know My Father also."

verses.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.modern: He spoke these words in the treasury, while teaching in the temple. No one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them again, "I am going away. You will look for Me, and You will die in Your sin. Where I am going, You cannot come."

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.modern: The Jews said, "Will He kill Himself? Is that what He means by saying, 'Where I am going, You cannot come'?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.modern: He said to them, "You are from below. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

verses.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.modern: That is why I told You that You will die in Your sins. For if You do not believe that I am He, You will die in Your sins."

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.modern: They said to Him, "Who are You?" Jesus answered, "Just what I have been telling You from the beginning.

verses.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.modern: I have much to say about You and much to judge. But He who sent Me is true, and I tell the world what I have heard from Him."

verses.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.modern: They did not understand that He was speaking to them about the Father.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.modern: So Jesus said to them, "When You have lifted up the Son of Man, then You will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own. I speak just what the Father has taught Me.

verses.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.modern: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, for I always do what pleases Him."

verses.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.modern: As He spoke these words, many believed in Him.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.modern: Jesus said to the Jews who had believed in Him, "If You continue in My word, You are truly My disciples.

verses.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.modern: You will know the truth, and the truth will set You free."

verses.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.modern: They answered Him, "We are Abraham's descendants and have never been enslaved to anyone. How can you say, 'You will be made free'?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I say to You, everyone who commits sin is a slave to sin.

verses.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.modern: A slave does not remain in the house forever. The Son remains forever.

verses.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.modern: So if the Son sets You free, You will be truly free.

verses.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.modern: I know that you are Abraham's descendants. Yet you seek to kill Me because My word finds no place in you.

verses.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.modern: I speak of what I have seen with My Father, and you do what you have heard from your father."

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.modern: They answered Him, "Abraham is our father." Jesus said to them, "If You were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.

verses.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.modern: But now you seek to kill Me — a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do this.

verses.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
verses.modern: You are doing the works of your father." They said to Him, "We were not born of fornication. We have one Father — God Himself."

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "If God were Your Father, You would love Me. I came from God and I am here. I did not come on My own — He sent Me.

verses.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.modern: Why do You not understand what I say? It is because You cannot bear to hear My word.

verses.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.modern: You are of your father the devil, and you want to carry out your father's desires. He was a murderer from the beginning and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language — for he is a liar and the father of lies.

verses.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.modern: But because I tell the truth, you do not believe Me.

verses.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.modern: Which of you can charge Me with sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe Me?

verses.kjv: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
verses.modern: Whoever is of God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear them is that you are not of God."

verses.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.modern: The Jews answered Him, "Are we not right in saying that You are a Samaritan and have a devil?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "I do not have a devil. I honor My Father, and You dishonor Me.

verses.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.modern: I am not seeking My own glory. There is One who seeks it and judges.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death."

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.modern: The Jews said to Him, "Now we know You have a devil! Abraham died, and so did the prophets. Yet you say, 'If anyone keeps My word, he will never taste death.'

verses.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.modern: Are You greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died too! Who do you make Yourself out to be?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing. It is My Father who glorifies Me — He of whom You say, 'He is our God.'

verses.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.modern: Yet You have not known Him. But I know Him. If I were to say I do not know Him, I would be a liar like You. But I do know Him and I keep His word.

verses.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.modern: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing My day. He saw it and was glad."

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.modern: The Jews said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have You seen Abraham?"

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to You, before Abraham was, I am."

verses.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.modern: At this they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple, passing through the middle of them and going away.

chapters.summary: The scribes and Pharisees bring a woman caught in adultery to Jesus, and He tells them, 'He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.' Jesus declares, 'I am the light of the world,' and tells the Jews that before Abraham was, 'I AM,' provoking them to take up stones against Him.

verses.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.modern: As Jesus walked along, He saw a man who had been blind from birth.

verses.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.modern: His disciples asked Him, "Master, who sinned — this man or his parents — that he was born blind?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Neither this man nor his parents sinned. He was born blind so that the works of God might be displayed in Him.

verses.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.modern: I must do the works of Him who sent Me while it is still day. Night is coming, when no one can work.

verses.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.modern: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

verses.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.modern: After saying this, He spat on the ground and made mud with the saliva. He spread the mud on the man's eyes

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.modern: He said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means Sent). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.

verses.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.modern: His neighbors and those who had seen him before as a beggar asked, "Is this not the man who used to sit and beg?"

verses.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.modern: Some said, "It is him." Others said, "No, he just looks like him." But the man himself said, "I am the one."

verses.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.modern: So they asked him, "How were your eyes opened?"

verses.kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.modern: He answered, "A man called Jesus made mud and spread it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. I went and washed, and I received my sight."

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.modern: They asked Him, "Where is He?" He said, "I don't know."

verses.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.modern: They brought the man who had been blind to the Pharisees.

verses.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.modern: Now it was the Sabbath day when Jesus had made the mud and opened His eyes.

verses.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.modern: The Pharisees asked Him again how He had received His sight. He said to them, "He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and now I see."

verses.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.modern: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath." Others said, "How can a sinful man do such signs?" And there was a division among them.

verses.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.modern: They asked the blind man again, "What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."

verses.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.modern: The Jews did not believe that he had been blind and received his sight, until they called the parents of the man who had received his sight.

verses.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.modern: They asked his parents, "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How does he now see?"

verses.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.modern: His parents answered, "We know that this is our son and that he was born blind.

verses.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him, he shall speak for himself.
verses.modern: But how he now sees, we do not know. We do not know who opened his eyes. He is of age — ask him. He can speak for himself."

verses.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.modern: His parents said this because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had already agreed that if anyone confessed Jesus to be the Christ, He would be put out of the synagogue.

verses.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.modern: That is why His parents said, "He is of age — ask Him."

verses.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.modern: So they called the man who had been blind a second time and said to him, "Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner."

verses.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.modern: He answered, "Whether He is a sinner, I don't know. One thing I know — I was blind, and now I see."

verses.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.modern: They asked him again, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"

verses.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.modern: He answered them, "I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?"

verses.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.modern: Then they insulted him and said, "You are His disciple. We are disciples of Moses.

verses.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.modern: We know that God spoke to Moses. As for this man, we do not know where he comes from."

verses.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.modern: The man answered them, "This is remarkable — you do not know where He comes from, yet He opened my eyes.

verses.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.modern: We know that God does not listen to sinners. But if anyone worships God and does His will, God listens to Him.

verses.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.modern: Never since the world began has anyone opened the eyes of a man born blind.

verses.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.modern: If this man were not from God, He could do nothing."

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.modern: They answered him, "You were born entirely in sin, and are you teaching us?" And they threw him out.

verses.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.modern: Jesus heard that they had thrown Him out. When He found Him, He said, "Do You believe in the Son of God?"

verses.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.modern: He answered, "Who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "You have seen Him. It is He who is speaking with you now."

verses.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.modern: He said, "Lord, I believe." And He worshipped Him.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "I came into this world for judgment — so that those who do not see may see, and those who do see may become blind."

verses.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.modern: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this and said to Him, "Are we blind also?"

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "If You were blind, You would have no sin. But now You say, 'We see.' Therefore Your sin remains."

chapters.summary: Jesus heals a man born blind by anointing his eyes with clay and sending him to wash in the pool of Siloam. The Pharisees interrogate the man and his parents, refusing to accept the miracle, and cast him out of the synagogue. Jesus finds him and reveals Himself as the Son of God.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.modern: "Truly, truly, I tell You — whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the door but climbs in by another way is a thief and a robber.

verses.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.modern: But whoever enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.modern: The gatekeeper opens for Him. The sheep hear His voice. He calls His own sheep by name and leads them out.

verses.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.modern: When He has brought out all His own, He goes before them, and the sheep follow Him because they know His voice.

verses.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.modern: They will not follow a stranger. They will run from Him, because they do not know the voice of strangers."

verses.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.modern: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they did not understand what He was saying to them.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.modern: So Jesus said to them again, "Truly, truly, I tell You — I am the door of the sheep.

verses.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.modern: All who came before Me are thieves and robbers. The sheep did not listen to them.

verses.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.modern: I am the door. Whoever enters through Me will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.

verses.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.modern: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life — and have it in full measure.

verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.modern: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep.

verses.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.modern: The hired hand is not the shepherd. The sheep are not His own. When He sees the wolf coming, He abandons the sheep and runs. The wolf catches them and scatters the flock.

verses.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.modern: He runs because He is a hired hand and does not care about the sheep.

verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.modern: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me.

verses.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.modern: Just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father — I lay down My life for the sheep.

verses.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
verses.modern: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them also. They will hear My voice, and there will be one flock and one shepherd.

verses.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.modern: The Father loves Me because I lay down My life so that I may take it up again.

verses.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.modern: No one takes it from Me. I lay it down of My own will. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. This command I received from My Father."

verses.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.modern: There was again a division among the Jews because of these words.

verses.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.modern: Many of them said, "He has a devil and is out of His mind. Why listen to Him?"

verses.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.modern: Others said, "These are not the words of someone possessed by a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?"

verses.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.modern: The Feast of Dedication came, and it was winter in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
verses.modern: Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon's Porch.

verses.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.modern: The Jews gathered around Him and said, "How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "I told You, and You do not believe. The works I do in My Father's name — they testify about Me.

verses.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.modern: But You do not believe, because You are not among My sheep — as I said to You.

verses.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.modern: My sheep hear My voice. I know them, and they follow Me.

verses.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.modern: I give them eternal life. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of My hand.

verses.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
verses.modern: My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of My Father's hand.

verses.kjv: I and my Father are one.
verses.modern: I and the Father are one."

verses.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.modern: The Jews picked up stones again to stone Him.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "I have shown You many good works from My Father. For which of those works are You stoning Me?"

verses.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.modern: The Jews answered Him, "We are not stoning You for a good work, but for blasphemy — because You, being a man, make yourself God."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in Your law, 'I said, You are gods'?

verses.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.modern: He called them gods — those to whom the word of God came — and Scripture cannot be broken.

verses.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.modern: Do You say of the one whom the Father set apart and sent into the world, 'You are blaspheming,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God'?

verses.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.modern: If I am not doing the works of My Father, do not believe Me.

verses.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
verses.modern: But if I am, even if You do not believe Me, believe the works — so that You may know and understand that the Father is in Me and I am in the Father."

verses.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.modern: So they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped from their hands.

verses.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.modern: He went away again across the Jordan to the place where John had first baptized, and he stayed there.

verses.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.modern: Many people came to Him and said, "John performed no sign, but everything John said about this man was true."

verses.kjv: And many believed on him there.
verses.modern: And many believed in Him there.

chapters.summary: Jesus declares, 'I am the good shepherd' who lays down His life for the sheep, and 'I am the door' by which the sheep enter. He teaches that He and the Father are one, and the Jews take up stones to kill Him for blasphemy. He withdraws beyond the Jordan, where many believe in Him.

verses.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.modern: Now a certain man was sick — Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.modern: This was the Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped His feet with her hair. It was her brother Lazarus who was sick.

verses.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.modern: So His sisters sent word to Jesus, saying, "Lord, the one You love is sick."

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.modern: When Jesus heard this, He said, "This sickness is not unto death. It is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it."

verses.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.modern: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

verses.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.modern: So when He heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed two more days in the place where He was.

verses.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.modern: After that He said to His disciples, "Let us go to Judaea again."

verses.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.modern: The disciples said to Him, "Master, the Jews were just trying to stone You, and You are going back there?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks in the day, he does not stumble, because He sees the light of this world.

verses.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.modern: But if anyone walks in the night, he stumbles, because there is no light in Him."

verses.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.modern: After saying this, He told them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep. But I am going to wake him."

verses.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.modern: His disciples said, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover."

verses.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.modern: Jesus had spoken of His death, but they thought He was talking about actual sleep.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.modern: So Jesus told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead.

verses.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.modern: I am glad for Your sake that I was not there — so that You may believe. But let us go to Him."

verses.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.modern: Thomas, called Didymus, said to the other disciples, "Let us also go, so that we may die with Him."

verses.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
verses.modern: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.

verses.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.modern: Bethany was near Jerusalem, about two miles away.

verses.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.modern: Many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them over the death of their brother.

verses.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
verses.modern: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet Him. But Mary stayed seated in the house.

verses.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.modern: Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.

verses.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
verses.modern: But even now I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."

verses.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.modern: Martha said to him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection on the last day."

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me, though he die, yet shall he live.

verses.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.modern: And whoever lives and believes in Me shall never die. Do You believe this?"

verses.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.modern: She said to Him, "Yes, Lord. I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, Who was to come into the world."

verses.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.modern: When she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary quietly, saying, "The Master is here and is calling for you."

verses.kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.modern: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.

verses.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.modern: Jesus had not yet entered the village — He was still in the place where Martha had met him.

verses.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.modern: The Jews who were with Mary in the house comforting her saw her get up quickly and go out. They followed her, thinking she was going to the tomb to weep there.

verses.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.modern: When Mary came where Jesus was and saw Him, she fell at His feet, saying, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died."

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled.
verses.modern: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

verses.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.modern: He asked, "Where have You laid Him?" They said to Him, "Lord, come and see."

verses.kjv: Jesus wept.
verses.modern: Jesus wept.

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.modern: Then the Jews said, "See how He loved Him!"

verses.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.modern: But some of them said, "Could not this man, who opened the eyes of the blind, have kept this man from dying?"

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.modern: Jesus, deeply moved again, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone was lying against it.

verses.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, "Lord, by this time there is a bad odor — He has been dead four days."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Did I not tell You that if You believe, You will see the glory of God?"

verses.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.modern: So they took away the stone. Jesus lifted up His eyes and said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.

verses.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.modern: I knew that You always hear Me. But I said this for the sake of the people standing here, so that they may believe that You sent Me."

verses.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.modern: When He had said this, He cried out with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

verses.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.modern: The man who had been dead came out, his hands and feet wrapped in burial cloths, and His face wrapped in a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Unwrap Him and let Him go."

verses.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.modern: Many of the Jews who had come to Mary and had seen what Jesus did believed in Him.

verses.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.modern: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

verses.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.modern: So the chief priests and the Pharisees called a council meeting and said, "What are we doing? This man is performing many signs.

verses.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.modern: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him. Then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation."

verses.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.modern: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all.

verses.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.modern: You do not understand that it is better for you that one man should die for the people than that the whole nation should perish."

verses.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.modern: He did not say this of His own accord. Being high priest that year, He prophesied that Jesus would die for that nation.

verses.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.modern: Not for that nation only, but also to gather into one the children of God Who were scattered abroad.

verses.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.modern: So from that day on they plotted to put Him to death.

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence into a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.modern: Jesus no longer walked openly among the Jews. He went from there to a region near the wilderness, to a town called Ephraim, and He stayed there with His disciples.

verses.kjv: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.modern: The Jewish Passover was near. Many people went up to Jerusalem from the countryside before the Passover to purify themselves.

verses.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.modern: They were looking for Jesus and saying to one another as they stood in the temple, "What do You think? Will He not come to the feast?"

verses.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
verses.modern: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where Jesus was, He should report it so they might arrest Him.

chapters.summary: Jesus raises Lazarus from the dead after four days in the tomb, weeping at the grave before commanding, 'Lazarus, come forth.' Many Jews believe in Him because of this sign. The chief priests and Pharisees, alarmed by the growing crowds, plot to put Jesus to death, and Caiaphas prophesies that Jesus would die for the nation.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.modern: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived — the one he had raised from the dead.

verses.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.modern: They made a supper for Him there. Martha served, and Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with Him.

verses.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.modern: Mary took a pound of very costly ointment of spikenard. She anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped His feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

verses.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
verses.modern: Then one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon — the one who would betray him — said,

verses.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.modern: "Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred coins and given to the poor?"

verses.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.modern: He said this not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief. He kept the money bag and used to steal from what was put in it.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Leave her alone. She has kept it for the day of My burial.

verses.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.modern: The poor You will always have with You, but You will not always have Me."

verses.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.modern: A large crowd of the Jews learned that He was there. They came not only for Jesus, but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.modern: But the chief priests planned to put Lazarus to death as well,

verses.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.modern: because on account of Him, many of the Jews were leaving and believing in Jesus.

verses.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.modern: The next day, the large crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.modern: They took branches of palm trees and went out to meet Him, crying, "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord — the King of Israel!"

verses.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.modern: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:

verses.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.modern: "Fear not, daughter of Zion. See, Your King is coming, sitting on a donkey's colt."

verses.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.modern: His disciples did not understand this at first. But when Jesus was glorified, they remembered that these things had been written about Him and that they had done these things to Him.

verses.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.modern: The crowd that had been with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to testify about it.

verses.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.modern: This was also why the crowd went out to meet Him — because they had heard that He had done this miracle.

verses.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.modern: So the Pharisees said to one another, "Do you see that you gain nothing? Look — the whole world has gone after Him."

verses.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.modern: Now there were some Greeks among those who had come to worship at the feast.

verses.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.modern: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and said to Him, "Sir, we wish to see Jesus."

verses.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.modern: Philip went and told Andrew. Andrew and Philip then went and told Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it produces much fruit.

verses.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.modern: Whoever loves his life will lose it. Whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

verses.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.modern: If anyone serves Me, let him follow Me. Where I am, My servant will also be. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor Him.

verses.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.modern: Now My soul is troubled. What shall I say? Father, save Me from this hour? No — for this reason I came to this hour.

verses.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.modern: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came from heaven: "I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again."

verses.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.modern: The crowd standing there heard it and said it was thunder. Others said, "An angel spoke to Him."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "This voice came not for My sake, but for Yours.

verses.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.modern: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

verses.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.modern: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to Myself."

verses.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.modern: He said this to show what kind of death He was going to die.

verses.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.modern: The crowd answered Him, "We have heard from the law that the Christ remains forever. How can You say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this Son of Man?"

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "The light is with You for a little while longer. Walk while You have the light, so that darkness does not overtake You. The one who walks in darkness does not know where he is going.

verses.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.modern: While You have the light, believe in the light, so that You may become children of light." When Jesus had said this, He departed and hid Himself from them.

verses.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.modern: Although He had done so many miracles before them, they still did not believe in Him,

verses.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.modern: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled: "Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

verses.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.modern: For this reason they could not believe. Isaiah also said,

verses.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.modern: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they would not see with their eyes or understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them."

verses.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.modern: Isaiah said these things because he saw his glory and spoke of Him.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.modern: Nevertheless, even among the rulers many believed in Him. But because of the Pharisees they did not confess it, so they would not be put out of the synagogue.

verses.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.modern: They loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

verses.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.modern: Jesus cried out and said, "Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in Him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.modern: Whoever sees Me sees him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.modern: I have come as a light into the world, so that whoever believes in Me should not remain in darkness.

verses.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.modern: If anyone hears My words and does not believe, I do not judge Him — for I came not to judge the world but to save the world.

verses.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.modern: Whoever rejects Me and does not receive My words has a judge — the very word I have spoken will judge Him on the last day.

verses.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.modern: I have not spoken on My own authority. The Father who sent Me has Himself commanded Me what to say and what to speak.

verses.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.modern: I know that His commandment is everlasting life. So whatever I speak, I speak just as the Father has told Me."

chapters.summary: Mary anoints Jesus's feet with costly spikenard at Bethany, and Judas objects. Jesus enters Jerusalem riding on a young donkey as the crowd cries 'Hosanna,' fulfilling prophecy. He declares that the hour has come for the Son of man to be glorified and that if He is lifted up, He will draw all men to Himself.

verses.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.modern: Before the feast of the Passover, Jesus knew that His hour had come to depart from this world to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.

verses.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
verses.modern: During supper, the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, to betray him.

verses.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.modern: Jesus knew that the Father had given all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was going to God.

verses.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.modern: He rose from supper, laid aside His outer garments, and took a towel and wrapped it around Himself.

verses.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.modern: Then He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples' feet, wiping them with the towel He had wrapped around Himself.

verses.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.modern: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you washing my feet?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "You do not understand what I am doing now, but You will understand afterward."

verses.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.modern: Peter said to him, "You shall never wash my feet." Jesus answered, "If I do not wash You, You have no part with Me."

verses.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.modern: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!"

verses.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "The one who has bathed does not need to wash except for His feet — he is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of You."

verses.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.modern: For He knew who was going to betray Him. That is why He said, "Not all of You are clean."

verses.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.modern: When He had washed their feet and put on His garments and sat down again, He said to them, "Do You understand what I have done to You?

verses.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
verses.modern: You call Me Master and Lord, and You are right, for that is what I am.

verses.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
verses.modern: If I then, Your Lord and Master, have washed Your feet, You also ought to wash one another's feet.

verses.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.modern: I have given You an example, so that You should do just as I have done to You.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, a servant is not greater than His master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

verses.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.modern: If You know these things, You are blessed if You do them.

verses.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.modern: I am not speaking of all of You. I know those I have chosen. But the Scripture must be fulfilled: 'He who ate bread with Me has lifted up his heel against Me.'

verses.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
verses.modern: I am telling You this now, before it happens, so that when it does happen You may believe that I am He.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, whoever receives the one I send receives Me. Whoever receives Me receives him who sent Me."

verses.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.modern: When Jesus had said this, He was troubled in spirit. He testified and said, "Truly, truly, I say to You, one of You will betray Me."

verses.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.modern: The disciples looked at one another, uncertain of whom He was speaking.

verses.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.modern: One of His disciples — the one whom Jesus loved — was reclining at Jesus' side.

verses.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.modern: Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus whom He meant.

verses.kjv: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.modern: That disciple leaned back against Jesus and said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread after I have dipped it." He dipped the piece of bread and gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.modern: After Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus said to Him, "What You are going to do, do quickly."

verses.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.modern: None of those at the table knew why He said this to Him.

verses.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.modern: Some thought that, since Judas had the money bag, Jesus was telling Him to buy what they needed for the feast, or that He should give something to the poor.

verses.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.modern: So after receiving the piece of bread, Judas went out immediately. It was night.

verses.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.modern: When He had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.

verses.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.modern: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and He will glorify Him at once.

verses.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.modern: Little children, I am with You only a little while longer. You will seek Me. As I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going You cannot come,' so I say to You now.

verses.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.modern: A new commandment I give to You: that You love one another. Just as I have loved You, You also are to love one another.

verses.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.modern: By this all people will know that You are My disciples — if You have love for one another."

verses.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.modern: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, where are you going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going You cannot follow Me now, but You will follow afterward."

verses.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.modern: Peter said, "Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will lay down my life for You."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Will You lay down Your life for Me? Truly, truly, I say to You, the rooster will not crow until You have denied Me three times."

chapters.summary: Jesus washes His disciples' feet at the Last Supper, commanding them to serve one another as He has served them. He reveals that one of them will betray Him, and Judas goes out into the night. Jesus gives a new commandment: 'Love one another, as I have loved you.'

verses.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.modern: "Do not let Your hearts be troubled. You believe in God — believe also in Me.

verses.kjv: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.modern: In My Father's house there are many mansions. If it were not so, I would have told You. I am going to prepare a place for You.

verses.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
verses.modern: And if I go and prepare a place for You, I will come again and receive You to Myself, so that where I am, there You may be also.

verses.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.modern: And where I am going, You know the way."

verses.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.modern: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we do not know where you are going. How can we know the way?"

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

verses.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.modern: If You had known Me, You would have known My Father also. From now on, You do know Him and have seen Him."

verses.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.modern: Philip said to him, "Lord, show us the Father, and that is enough for us."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Have I been with You so long, and You still do not know Me, Philip? Whoever has seen Me has seen the Father. How can You say, 'Show us the Father'?

verses.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.modern: Do You not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to You I do not speak on My own authority. The Father who lives in Me does His works.

verses.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
verses.modern: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father in Me — or else believe because of the works themselves.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, whoever believes in Me will do the works I do. He will do even greater works than these, because I am going to the Father.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.modern: Whatever You ask in My name, that I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
verses.modern: If You ask anything in My name, I will do it.

verses.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.modern: If You love Me, keep My commandments.

verses.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.modern: I will ask the Father, and He will give You another Comforter, to be with You forever —

verses.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.modern: even the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But You know Him, for He lives with You and will be in You.

verses.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.modern: I will not leave You comfortless. I will come to You.

verses.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.modern: A little while longer and the world will see Me no more. But You will see Me. Because I live, You will live also.

verses.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.modern: On that day You will know that I am in My Father, and You are in Me, and I am in You.

verses.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.modern: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them — he is the one who loves Me. Whoever loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love Him and reveal Myself to Him."

verses.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.modern: Judas — not Iscariot — said to him, "Lord, how is it that You will reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love Him, and We will come to Him and make Our home with Him.

verses.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
verses.modern: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word You hear is not Mine, but the Father's who sent Me.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
verses.modern: I have said these things while I am still with You.

verses.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.modern: But the Comforter — the Holy Ghost — whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach You all things and bring to Your remembrance all that I have said to You.

verses.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.modern: Peace I leave with You. My peace I give to You. Not as the world gives do I give to You. Do not let Your hearts be troubled, and do not be afraid.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.modern: You heard Me say, 'I am going away, and I will come back to You.' If You loved Me, You would rejoice, because I am going to the Father — for the Father is greater than I.

verses.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.modern: I have told You this now, before it happens, so that when it does happen You may believe.

verses.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.modern: I will not talk much more with you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no claim on Me.

verses.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.modern: But the world must know that I love the Father and do exactly as the Father commanded Me. Rise, let us go from here."

chapters.summary: Jesus comforts His disciples, telling them He goes to prepare a place for them and that He is the way, the truth, and the life. He promises to send the Comforter — the Holy Ghost — who will teach them all things and bring to remembrance everything He has said.

verses.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.modern: "I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.

verses.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.modern: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away. Every branch that does bear fruit He prunes, so that it may bear more fruit.

verses.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.modern: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to You.

verses.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
