verses.modern: Remain in Me, and I in You. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can You, unless You remain in Me.

verses.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.modern: I am the vine; You are the branches. Whoever remains in Me, and I in him, he bears much fruit. Apart from Me You can do nothing.

verses.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.modern: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown away like a branch and withers. Such branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned.

verses.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.modern: If You remain in Me and My words remain in You, ask whatever You wish, and it will be done for You.

verses.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.modern: This is how My Father is glorified — that You bear much fruit and show yourselves to be My disciples.

verses.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.modern: As the Father has loved Me, so I have loved You. Remain in My love.

verses.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.modern: If You keep My commandments, You will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father's commandments and remain in His love.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
verses.modern: I have said these things to You so that My joy may be in You, and that Your joy may be complete.

verses.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.modern: This is My commandment: that You love one another as I have loved You.

verses.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.modern: No one has greater love than this — that someone lay down his life for his friends.

verses.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.modern: You are My friends if You do what I command You.

verses.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.modern: I no longer call You servants, because a servant does not know what His master is doing. I have called You friends, for I have made known to You everything I have heard from My Father.

verses.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.modern: You did not choose Me, but I chose You. I appointed You to go and bear fruit — fruit that will last — so that whatever You ask the Father in My name, He may give it to You.

verses.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.modern: These things I command You: that You love one another.

verses.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
verses.modern: If the world hates You, know that it hated Me before it hated You.

verses.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.modern: If You were of the world, the world would love You as its own. But because You are not of the world — because I chose You out of the world — the world hates You.

verses.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.modern: Remember the word I said to You: 'A servant is not greater than His master.' If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute You. If they kept My word, they will keep Yours also.

verses.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.modern: They will do all these things to You on account of My name, because they do not know Him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
verses.modern: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.modern: Whoever hates Me hates My Father also.

verses.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.modern: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not have had sin. But now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.

verses.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.modern: But this has happened so that the word written in their law might be fulfilled: 'They hated Me without cause.'

verses.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.modern: But when the Comforter comes — whom I will send to You from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father — He will testify about Me.

verses.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.modern: And You also will testify, because You have been with Me from the beginning.

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches, 'I am the true vine,' and calls His disciples to abide in Him as branches abide in the vine. He commands them to love one another as He has loved them, warns that the world will hate them as it hated Him, and promises that the Comforter will come to testify of Him.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
verses.modern: "I have told You these things so that You will not fall away.

verses.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.modern: They will put You out of the synagogues. Indeed, the hour is coming when whoever kills you will think he is offering service to God.

verses.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.modern: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.

verses.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.modern: I have said these things to You so that when their hour comes You may remember that I told You of them. I did not say this to You from the beginning, because I was with You.

verses.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.modern: But now I am going to Him who sent Me. None of You asks Me, 'Where are You going?'

verses.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.modern: But because I have said these things, sorrow has filled Your hearts.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.modern: But I tell You the truth: it is to Your benefit that I go away. For if I do not go away, the Comforter will not come to You. But if I go, I will send Him to You.

verses.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.modern: When He comes, He will convict the world concerning sin, and righteousness, and judgment:

verses.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.modern: concerning sin, because they do not believe in Me;

verses.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.modern: concerning righteousness, because I go to the Father and You will see Me no more;

verses.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.modern: concerning judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

verses.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.modern: I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.

verses.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.modern: When the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide You into all truth. He will not speak on His own authority, but whatever He hears He will speak. He will declare to You the things that are to come.

verses.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.modern: He will glorify Me, for He will take what is Mine and declare it to You.

verses.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.modern: All that the Father has is Mine. That is why I said He will take what is Mine and declare it to You.

verses.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.modern: A little while and You will see Me no more. Then again a little while, and You will see Me, because I am going to the Father."

verses.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.modern: Some of His disciples said to one another, "What does He mean by saying, 'A little while and You will not see Me, and again a little while and You will see Me,' and 'because I am going to the Father'?"

verses.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.modern: They kept asking, "What does He mean by 'a little while'? We do not know what He is talking about."

verses.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.modern: Jesus knew they wanted to ask Him, so He said to them, "Are You discussing among yourselves what I meant by 'a little while and You will not see Me, and again a little while and You will see Me'?

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, You will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but Your sorrow will turn to joy.

verses.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.modern: When a woman is giving birth, she has sorrow because her hour has come. But when she has delivered the baby, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a child has been born into the world.

verses.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.modern: So also You have sorrow now. But I will see You again, and Your hearts will rejoice. No one will take your joy from you.

verses.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
verses.modern: On that day You will ask Me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to You, whatever You ask the Father in My name, He will give it to You.

verses.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.modern: Until now You have asked nothing in My name. Ask, and You will receive, so that Your joy may be complete.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.modern: I have said these things to You in figures of speech. The hour is coming when I will no longer speak in figures but will tell You plainly about the Father.

verses.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.modern: On that day You will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on Your behalf —

verses.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.modern: for the Father Himself loves You, because You have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.

verses.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.modern: I came from the Father and entered the world. Now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father."

verses.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.modern: His disciples said, "Now You are speaking plainly and not using figures of speech.

verses.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.modern: Now we know that You know all things. You do not need anyone to ask you anything. By this we believe that You came from God."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Do You now believe?

verses.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.modern: The hour is coming — indeed, it has already come — when You will be scattered, each to His own home, and will leave Me alone. Yet I am not alone, for the Father is with Me.

verses.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.modern: I have said these things to You so that in Me You may have peace. In the world You will have trouble. But take courage — I have overcome the world."

chapters.summary: Jesus warns His disciples that they will be put out of the synagogues and that those who kill them will think they are serving God. He promises that the Comforter will come to convict the world of sin, righteousness, and judgment. He tells them that their sorrow will be turned to joy, and declares, 'I have overcome the world.'

verses.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
verses.modern: When Jesus had said these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, "Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son so that the Son may glorify You,

verses.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
verses.modern: just as You have given Him authority over all flesh, to give eternal life to all whom You have given Him.

verses.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.modern: And this is eternal life: that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

verses.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
verses.modern: I have glorified You on earth. I have finished the work You gave Me to do.

verses.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.modern: Now, Father, glorify Me in Your own presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.

verses.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.modern: I have made Your name known to the people you gave Me out of the world. They were Yours, and You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

verses.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
verses.modern: Now they know that everything You have given Me is from You.

verses.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
verses.modern: I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They know truly that I came from You, and they have believed that You sent Me.

verses.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
verses.modern: I am praying for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those You have given Me, for they are Yours.

verses.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.modern: All that is Mine is Yours, and what is Yours is Mine, and I am glorified in them.

verses.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
verses.modern: I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, keep them in Your name — the name You have given Me — so that they may be one, just as We are one.

verses.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.modern: While I was with them, I kept them in Your name. I protected those You gave Me, and none of them has been lost except the son of perdition, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

verses.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.modern: Now I am coming to You. I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have My joy made complete in themselves.

verses.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.modern: I have given them Your word, and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

verses.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
verses.modern: I am not asking You to take them out of the world, but to keep them from the evil one.

verses.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.modern: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

verses.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
verses.modern: Sanctify them in Your truth — Your word is truth.

verses.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.modern: As You sent Me into the world, I also have sent them into the world.

verses.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
verses.modern: For their sake I sanctify Myself, so that they also may be sanctified in truth.

verses.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
verses.modern: I do not ask for these only, but also for those who will believe in Me through their word,

verses.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.modern: that they all may be one. Just as You, Father, are in Me and I in You, may they also be one in Us, so that the world may believe that You have sent Me.

verses.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.modern: The glory You have given Me I have given to them, so that they may be one, just as We are one —

verses.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
verses.modern: I in them, and You in Me — so that they may be perfected into one. Then the world will know that You sent Me and that You have loved them just as You have loved Me.

verses.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.modern: Father, I desire that those You have given Me may also be with Me where I am, to see My glory, which You have given Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

verses.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
verses.modern: Righteous Father, the world has not known You, but I have known You. These people know that You have sent Me.

verses.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.modern: I have made Your name known to them, and I will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them."

chapters.summary: Jesus prays to the Father, asking Him to glorify the Son so that the Son may glorify the Father. He prays for His disciples, asking the Father to keep them from the evil one and to sanctify them through the truth. He prays for all who will believe through their word, that they may be one as He and the Father are one.

verses.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.modern: When Jesus had said these things, He went out with His disciples across the brook Cedron, where there was a garden, and He and His disciples entered it.

verses.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.modern: Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.

verses.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.modern: So Judas, having obtained a band of soldiers and some officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.modern: Then Jesus, knowing all that was coming on Him, stepped forward and said to them, "Whom are You seeking?"

verses.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.modern: They answered Him, "Jesus of Nazareth." Jesus said to them, "I am He." Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

verses.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.modern: When He said to them, "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground.

verses.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.modern: He asked them again, "Whom are You seeking?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "I told You that I am He. So if You are looking for Me, let these others go."

verses.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.modern: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: "Of those You gave Me, I have lost none."

verses.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
verses.modern: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.modern: Jesus said to Peter, "Put your sword into its sheath. Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?"

verses.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.modern: So the band of soldiers, along with their commander and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound Him.

verses.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.modern: They led Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

verses.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.modern: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was better for one man to die for the people.

verses.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.modern: Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. That disciple was known to the high priest and entered the courtyard of the high priest with Jesus,

verses.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.modern: but Peter stood outside at the door. The other disciple — the one known to the high priest — went out and spoke to the woman at the door and brought Peter in.

verses.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.modern: The servant woman at the door said to Peter, "Are you not also one of this man's disciples?" He said, "I am not."

verses.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.modern: Now the servants and officers had made a charcoal fire because it was cold, and they were standing and warming themselves. Peter also was standing with them and warming himself.

verses.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.modern: The high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and about His teaching.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in the synagogues and in the temple, where all the Jews gather. I said nothing in secret.

verses.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.modern: Why do You ask Me? Ask those who heard Me what I said to them. They know what I said."

verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.modern: When He said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with His hand, saying, "Is that how You answer the high priest?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "If I said something wrong, testify about the wrong. But if I spoke rightly, why do You strike Me?"

verses.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.modern: Then Annas sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
verses.modern: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said to him, "Are you not also one of His disciples?" He denied it and said, "I am not."

verses.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.modern: One of the servants of the high priest — a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off — said, "Did I not see you in the garden with Him?"

verses.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.modern: Peter denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.modern: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor's headquarters. It was early morning. They themselves did not enter the governor's headquarters, so that they would not be defiled but could eat the Passover.

verses.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.modern: So Pilate went out to them and said, "What accusation do you bring against this man?"

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.modern: They answered him, "If this man were not a criminal, we would not have handed Him over to you."

verses.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.modern: Pilate said to them, "Take him yourselves and judge Him by your own law." The Jews said to him, "It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death."

verses.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.modern: This was to fulfill the word of Jesus, which He spoke to show what kind of death He would die.

verses.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.modern: So Pilate entered the headquarters again and called Jesus and said to Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Do You say this on Your own, or did others tell You about Me?"

verses.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.modern: Pilate answered, "Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have handed You over to me. What have You done?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would have been fighting to keep Me from being handed over to the Jews. But My kingdom is not from here."

verses.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.modern: Pilate said to him, "So you are a king?" Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. For this reason I was born, and for this reason I came into the world — to testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to My voice."

verses.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verses.modern: Pilate said to him, "What is truth?" After he said this, he went back out to the Jews and told them, "I find no fault in Him at all.

verses.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.modern: But you have a custom that I should release one man for you at the Passover. So do you want me to release for you the King of the Jews?"

verses.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.modern: They cried out again, "Not this man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.

chapters.summary: Judas leads a band of soldiers to the Garden of Gethsemane, and Jesus is arrested after Peter cuts off the ear of the high priest's servant. Jesus is questioned before Annas and Caiaphas, and Peter denies Him three times. Jesus is brought before Pontius Pilate, who finds no fault in Him, but the crowd demands Barabbas.

verses.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
verses.modern: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.

verses.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.modern: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on His head. They dressed Him in a purple robe

verses.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.modern: and kept coming up to Him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!" They struck Him with their hands.

verses.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.modern: Pilate went out again and said to them, "See, I am bringing Him out to you so that you may know that I find no fault in Him."

verses.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
verses.modern: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to them, "Look at the man!"

verses.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
verses.modern: When the chief priests and the officers saw Him, they cried out, "Crucify Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Take him yourselves and crucify Him — I find no fault in Him."

verses.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.modern: The Jews answered Him, "We have a law, and according to our law He ought to die, because He made Himself the Son of God."

verses.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.modern: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid.

verses.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.modern: He went back into the headquarters and said to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus gave Him no answer.

verses.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
verses.modern: So Pilate said to him, "You will not speak to me? Do you not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "You would have no authority over Me at all unless it had been given You from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you has the greater sin."

verses.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
verses.modern: From then on Pilate sought to release him. But the Jews cried out, "If you release this man, you are not Caesar's friend. Whoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar."

verses.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.modern: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called the Pavement — in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

verses.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
verses.modern: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, "Look at Your King!"

verses.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
verses.modern: They cried out, "Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar."

verses.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
verses.modern: So He handed Him over to them to be crucified. They took Jesus,

verses.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.modern: and He went out, carrying His own cross, to the place called the Place of a Skull — in the Hebrew, Golgotha.

verses.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.modern: There they crucified Him, along with two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.

verses.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.modern: Pilate also wrote a title and put it on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
verses.modern: Many of the Jews read this title, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city. It was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

verses.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.modern: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write, 'The King of the Jews,' but rather, 'This man said, I am King of the Jews.'"

verses.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.modern: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."

verses.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.modern: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took His garments and divided them into four parts — one for each soldier. But His tunic was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

verses.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.modern: So they said to one another, "Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to see whose it will be." This was to fulfill the Scripture: "They divided My clothes among them, and for My clothing they cast lots." These things the soldiers did.

verses.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.modern: Standing by the cross of Jesus were His mother, His mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
verses.modern: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to His mother, "Woman, see Your son!"

verses.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
verses.modern: Then He said to the disciple, "See your mother!" From that hour the disciple took her into his own home.

verses.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
verses.modern: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things were now finished, said — to fulfill the Scripture — "I am thirsty."

verses.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
verses.modern: A jar full of sour wine was standing there. They put a sponge full of the sour wine on a hyssop branch and held it to His mouth.

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.modern: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished." He bowed His head and gave up the ghost.

verses.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) sought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.modern: Since it was the day of Preparation, the Jews did not want the bodies left on the cross on the Sabbath — for that Sabbath was a high day — so they asked Pilate to have their legs broken and the bodies taken away.

verses.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.modern: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man and of the other who had been crucified with Him.

verses.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.modern: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.

verses.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.modern: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.

verses.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
verses.modern: The one who saw this has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows He is telling the truth, so that You also may believe.

verses.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.modern: These things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of His bones will be broken."

verses.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.modern: And again another Scripture says, "They will look on Him whom they pierced."

verses.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
verses.modern: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea — who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly, for fear of the Jews — asked Pilate for permission to take away the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission. So he came and took away Jesus' body.

verses.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
verses.modern: Nicodemus also came — the man who had first come to Jesus at night — bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.

verses.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
verses.modern: They took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.

verses.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.modern: Now there was a garden in the place where He was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.

verses.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.modern: So because of the Jewish day of Preparation, and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

chapters.summary: Pilate has Jesus scourged and the soldiers crown Him with thorns and mock Him. Pilate delivers Jesus to be crucified at Golgotha, where He is nailed to the cross between two others. Jesus commits His mother to John's care, declares 'It is finished,' and gives up His spirit. Joseph of Arimathaea and Nicodemus bury Him.

verses.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.modern: On the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early, while it was still dark. She saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

verses.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.modern: She ran and went to Simon Peter and the other disciple — the one whom Jesus loved — and said to them, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him."

verses.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.modern: Peter went out, along with the other disciple, and they were going to the tomb.

verses.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.modern: Both were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

verses.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.modern: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.

verses.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.modern: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and he went into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there,

verses.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.modern: and the face cloth that had been on His head — not lying with the linen cloths, but folded up in a place by itself.

verses.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.modern: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. He saw and believed.

verses.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.modern: For as yet they did not understand the Scripture, that He must rise from the dead.

verses.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.modern: Then the disciples went back to their own homes.

verses.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
verses.modern: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. As she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb.

verses.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.modern: She saw two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had lain — one at the head and one at the feet.

verses.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.modern: They said to her, "Woman, why are You weeping?" She said to them, "They have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."

verses.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.modern: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, but she did not know it was Jesus.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are You weeping? Whom are You seeking?" Thinking He was the gardener, she said to Him, "Sir, if You have carried Him away, tell me where You have laid Him, and I will take Him."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned and said to him, "Rabboni!" — which means Master.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
verses.modern: Jesus said to her, "Do not hold on to Me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go to My brothers and say to them, 'I am ascending to My Father and Your Father, and to My God and Your God.'"

verses.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.modern: Mary Magdalene went and told the disciples, "I have seen the Lord" — and she told them what He had said to her.

verses.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.modern: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the doors were locked where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with You."

verses.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.modern: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them again, "Peace be with You. As the Father has sent Me, so I am sending You."

verses.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.modern: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
verses.modern: If You forgive the sins of anyone, they are forgiven. If you retain the sins of anyone, they are retained."

verses.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.modern: Now Thomas, one of the twelve — called Didymus — was not with them when Jesus came.

verses.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.modern: So the other disciples told Him, "We have seen the Lord." But He said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, put my finger into the nail marks, and put my hand into His side, I will not believe."

verses.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
verses.modern: Eight days later, His disciples were inside again, and Thomas was with them. The doors were locked, but Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with You."

verses.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.modern: Then He said to Thomas, "Put your finger here, and see My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Do not be faithless, but believing."

verses.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.modern: Thomas answered him, "My Lord and my God!"

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Because You have seen Me, You have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."

verses.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.modern: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples that are not written in this book.

verses.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.modern: But these are written so that You may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing You may have life in His name.

chapters.summary: Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early on the first day of the week and finds it empty. The risen Jesus appears to her, then to the disciples behind locked doors, showing them His hands and His side. Thomas, absent the first time, sees Jesus eight days later and confesses, 'My Lord and my God.'

verses.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
verses.modern: After this, Jesus revealed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias. He revealed Himself in this way.

verses.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.modern: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other of His disciples were together.

verses.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.modern: Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They said to him, "We will go with you." They went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.

verses.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.modern: Just as day was breaking, Jesus stood on the shore. Yet the disciples did not know it was Jesus.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Children, have You caught any fish?" They answered Him, "No."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and You will find some." So they cast it, and now they were not able to haul it in because of the great number of fish.

verses.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.modern: That disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment — for He was stripped for work — and threw Himself into the sea.

verses.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.modern: The other disciples came in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, for they were not far from land — only about a hundred yards.

verses.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.modern: When they got out on land, they saw a charcoal fire in place, with fish laid on it and bread.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish You have just caught."

verses.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.modern: So Simon Peter went and hauled the net ashore, full of large fish — a hundred and fifty-three of them. Even though there were so many, the net was not torn.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Come and have breakfast." None of the disciples dared ask Him, "Who are You?" They knew it was the Lord.

verses.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.modern: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and so with the fish.

verses.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.modern: This was now the third time that Jesus revealed Himself to the disciples after He had risen from the dead.

verses.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.modern: When they had eaten breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonas, do you love Me more than these?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I love You." He said to Him, "Feed My lambs."

verses.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.modern: He said to Him again a second time, "Simon, son of Jonas, do you love Me?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He said to Him, "Tend My sheep."

verses.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.modern: He said to Him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonas, do you love Me?" Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, "Do You love Me?" He said to Him, "Lord, You know all things. You know that I love You." Jesus said to Him, "Feed My sheep.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
verses.modern: Truly, truly, I say to You, when You were young, You used to dress Yourself and go wherever You wanted. But when You are old, You will stretch out Your hands and another will dress You and carry You where You do not want to go."

verses.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.modern: He said this to show by what kind of death Peter would glorify God. After saying this, He said to Him, "Follow Me."

verses.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.modern: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following — the one who had also leaned against him at supper and had said, "Lord, who is it that will betray You?"

verses.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.modern: When Peter saw him, he said to Jesus, "Lord, what about this man?"

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "If I want Him to wait until I come, what is that to You? You follow Me."

verses.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
verses.modern: So this word spread among the brothers that that disciple would not die. Yet Jesus had not said to Him that He would not die, but, "If I want Him to wait until I come, what is that to You?"

verses.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.modern: This is the disciple who testifies about these things and who wrote these things down. We know that his testimony is true.

verses.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.modern: There are also many other things that Jesus did. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that would need to be written. Amen.

chapters.summary: The risen Jesus appears to seven disciples at the Sea of Tiberias and directs them to a miraculous catch of 153 fish. He restores Peter with three questions — 'Do you love Me?' — and commissions him to feed His sheep. Jesus foretells Peter's death and speaks concerning the beloved disciple.
